_meta.what: One stored printing record per candidate card for the 195 new Mechanical Color Pie examples. Pulled from the Scryfall API on 2026-10-09. The page needs no API call: it shows the image from img and the facts beside it.

fields.name: card name
fields.cn: collector number (set/cn is a pin code)
fields.img: card image (488x680, Scryfall image server, no rate limit)
fields.use: which printing this record is: returned (what Scryfall returns by default), newest, or oldest
fields.why: present when Scryfall's returned printing was a problem
fields.swap: the other printings, for swaps; the page does not use them

_meta.rule: Keep what Scryfall returns. If it is a problem (a Universes Beyond crossover, a digital-only scan, or a low-resolution image): use the newest regular paper printing in the modern frame with a sharp scan; else the oldest regular paper printing; else keep what Scryfall returned.
_meta.credit: Card images and data via Scryfall. Magic: The Gathering is (c) Wizards of the Coast.
